statement.zh: 杰姆代特奈斯尔遗址的 1920 年代发掘材料经 Matthews 2002 正式出版；该地名亦用作晚乌鲁克之后过渡阶段的器物组合/期名。
statement.en: Materials from the 1920s excavations at Jemdet Nasr were finally published by Matthews 2002; the site-name also labels a post–Late Uruk transitional assemblage/period.

editorial.notes: Fact about publication and period naming practice.
